![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f660c11e17a3532b3fdf658417814cbb76a7e62.jpeg)

📜 Commands

🚀 /spawn
Teleports you to the configured spawn location.

📍 /setspawn
Sets your current location as the server spawn point.

ℹ️ /moonspawn info
Displays plugin information, the active language, and the current spawn status.

🔄 /moonspawn reload
Reloads the configuration and language files.

🌐 /moonspawn lang <tr|en|es>
Changes the plugin language.



![perm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1978392b0a1809c524fb9927f3d3d81839b22d4c.jpeg)

🔐 Permission List

🎮 moonspawn.spawn
Allows players to use the /spawn command.
Default: true

🛠️ moonspawn.setspawn
Allows players to set the server spawn point using /setspawn.
Default: op

👑 moonspawn.admin
Grants access to all administrative commands (/moonspawn, /mspawn, /ms).
Default: op

⏱️ moonspawn.bypass.cooldown
Bypasses the spawn teleport cooldown.
Default: op
